name: Mote
description: Baseline unit, issued in quantity. Closes on the Engine and is destroyed on contact. Not expected to survive engagement.

name: Drifter
description: Standard chassis. Closes at a steady rate and does not manoeuvre. Most site procedure is written around this unit.

name: Charger
description: Holds, commits to a straight run, and cannot correct once committed. The pause before the run is deliberate and is not a fault.

name: Bulwark
description: Frontal plating stops projectile fire. Ineffective against fire arriving from the flank or behind, and against effects that do not travel.

name: Splitter
description: Divides on destruction. Each fragment continues the engagement, so asset count rises before it falls.

name: Interceptor
description: Consumes projectiles in flight. Capacity is finite; a unit at capacity destabilises and is expended as a blast. Feeding it is the intended use.

name: Suppressor
description: Carries no weapon. Projects a field within which the Engine cannot fire. The primary containment measure and the reason the Engine relocates.

name: Leech
description: Draws off accumulated charge on contact. Deployed against Engines that bank resources rather than spend them.

name: Lancer
description: Engages at range along a fixed line. The line is drawn before discharge. Procedure limits how many may charge at once.

name: Warden
description: Escalation unit, deployed at intervals once severity passes threshold. Carries site modifications as standard.

name: Shielded Mote
description: Baseline unit with frontal plating fitted. Same chassis, same expectancy.

name: Charged Mote
description: Baseline unit carrying an unstable charge. Detonates on destruction. Engage at distance.

name: Ghost Mote
description: Baseline unit with intermittent phase. Fire passes through while out of phase. The interval is fixed and can be timed.

name: Brood Drifter
description: Standard chassis, seeded. Destruction releases the seeded units. Asset count rises where these are engaged.

name: Plated Drifter
description: Standard chassis with frontal plating fitted. Flank it, or use effects that do not travel.

name: Spined Drifter
description: Standard chassis with contact spines. Returns damage to anything closing to touch, including the Engine.

name: Crowned Charger
description: Reinforced charge unit. Commits harder and takes considerably more to stop. The telegraph is unchanged.

name: Powder Charger
description: Charge unit carrying an unstable charge. Detonates at the end of its run, whether or not the run connects.
